bullets.title: HPE: Monster Beat and Raise on AI Server/Networking Demand — Street Upgrades PT Range $39–$79
bullets.body: HPE F2Q26 revenue $10.7B (+40% YoY) beat guidance $9.6–10.0B and consensus $9.8B; non-GAAP EPS $0.79 beat guidance by ~50%; AI orders of $2.1B in quarter with cumulative bookings $16.4B and $5.9B backlog. FY26 EPS guide raised to $3.35–3.45 (prior $2.30–2.50) on 29–33% revenue growth. FY27 early guide: 8–12% revenue, 12–16% EPS growth, FCF ≥$4.5B. Elliott Management's Chris Hsu joins board. PT range: Goldman $79, JPM $68, Morgan Stanley $71, Citi $70, Wolfe Peer Perform. Primary concern is demand durability vs. potential pull-forward.

bullets.title: MRVL +21% Pre-Market: Jensen Huang Calls Marvell 'Next $1T Company' at Computex
bullets.body: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang publicly endorsed Marvell at Computex Taiwan, calling it the next trillion-dollar company and an undisputed leader in AI connectivity. NVDA had invested $2B in MRVL in March. Multiple analysts noted the interconnect bottleneck thesis as key to the call; Goldman raised MRVL PT to $250 on strong quarterly beat and $600M+ FY27 optical revenue outlook.

bullets.title: GOOGL -2.8%: Announces $80B Equity Raise (incl. $10B Berkshire) for AI Infrastructure
bullets.body: Alphabet announced a massive equity capital raise comprising $40B ATM, $15B common stock offering, $15B mandatory convertibles, and a $10B private placement to Berkshire Hathaway to fund AI infrastructure. 2026 CapEx guide is $190B with 2027 spending expected to increase materially. OpCo and Jefferies flagged the equity-over-debt choice as a sign AI datacenter financing conditions are less favorable, potentially pressuring META too. Jim Chanos noted GOOGL held $126B in cash/securities as of March 31.

bullets.title: INTU: Goldman Downgrades to Sell, PT $276 (22% Downside) on AI Tax Competition
bullets.body: Goldman Sachs cut Intuit from Neutral to Sell with a $276 PT, implying 22% downside from ~$354. Analyst Gabriela Borges cited AI-driven competition in the tax business causing potential market share loss and ARPU pressure; Goldman's FY28 EPS estimates are 13% below Street. INTU fell ~5.9% pre-market. Additional headwinds include Mailchimp growth deceleration and expected margin compression.

bullets.title: CRDO: Strong FY27 Outlook on Optical Ramp; Roth/Goldman/JPM Raise PTs to $250–$300
bullets.body: Credo F4Q26 revenue $437M (+157% YoY) beat consensus; gross margins 68.3% vs. 65.4% estimate. FY27 revenue guide of 80%+ growth with $600M+ optical revenue (~25% of total). JPM raised PT to $250, Roth to $300, Mizuho to $290, Goldman to $250—all maintaining Outperform/Buy. F1Q27 guide $465–475M beats $460M consensus. CRDO traded down ~12% post-close on the night (Roth noted guidance was below buyside expectations) but recovered on broader AI enthusiasm.

bullets.title: NVDA: Computex Keynote Catalysts — Vera CPU, RTX Spark PC Chip, 50%+ FCF Return
bullets.body: Jensen Huang's Computex keynote highlighted Vera CPU (1.8x faster than x86, full production), demand for Vera expected to exceed GPU lineup, RTX Spark with 128GB LPDDR5X targeting PC/local AI market, and DGX Station with 748GB total memory. CEO confirmed supply adequate for robust growth but acknowledged constraints. Citi maintains $300 PT (28x CY27E). NVDA also confirmed China chip sales remain compliant with export control laws.

bullets.title: DELL: Goldman Raises PT to $500 on Agentic-AI Enterprise IT Demand; +269% YTD
bullets.body: Goldman raised DELL PT from $230 to $500 citing F1Q27 beat-and-raise driven by enterprise IT modernization and net-new agentic-AI workload demand. Trump personally bought $1M–$5M of DELL per disclosures, and the company secured a $9.7B Pentagon contract. Stock is up 269% YTD.

bullets.title: CRM -3.2%: Acquires Contentful for ~$1B–$1.5B; Salesforce's Anthropic Stake Now $5B
bullets.body: Salesforce signed a definitive agreement to acquire Contentful, a composable content platform with 4,800+ brands, for between $1B and $1.5B (deal expected to close Q3 FY27). The acquisition weighed on the stock. Separately, Salesforce's stake in Anthropic is now valued at ~$5B following Anthropic's $65B raise at a $900B+ valuation.

bullets.title: NTAP: Goldman Raises PT to $200 on Record Margins and Enterprise AI/Cloud Strength
bullets.body: Goldman raised NTAP PT from $127 to $200 following F4Q26 beat-and-raise driven by record operating margins, robust top-line, and continued enterprise AI and public cloud strength.

bullets.title: STX / WDC: Citi Raises PTs on Durable AI HDD Demand; Supply Shortfall Through 2028
bullets.body: Citi raised estimates and price targets on both STX and WDC following management meetings. Industry exabyte demand tracking ~25% CAGR with current supply running ~200 EBs short in CY26, expected to persist through CY28. HDD makers are focusing on areal density gains (no new unit capacity), NAND substitution remains prohibitive at current prices, and management tone is described as very bullish on long-term FCF and shareholder returns.

bullets.title: ORCL: UBS Raises PT to $285, Bullish Ahead of Earnings on AI Compute Tailwinds
bullets.body: UBS raised Oracle PT from $250 to $285 (Buy), seeing no momentum setback in database/applications/OCI from customer checks. Abilene data center build-out on track; FY27 preliminary guide of ~33% revenue growth to $90B and non-GAAP EPS of $8.00. Stock +28% YTD. OpenAI and Oracle breaking ground on a $16B 1GW data center campus in Michigan.

bullets.title: AVGO: F2Q26 Earnings Preview — AI Accelerators, TPU Volumes, and GOOGL Shift Key Focuses
bullets.body: Street consensus for AVGO F2Q26: revenue $22.1B (above $22B guidance low-end), gross margin 76.9%, EPS $2.40. F3Q26 consensus $28.25B revenue, $3.16 EPS. Key investor focus: AI accelerator/TPU volumes and FY27 growth outlook, VMware ARR, and any commentary on GOOGL potentially shifting some SKUs to MediaTek. Earnings due Wednesday after close.

bullets.title: U (Unity): Piper Sandler Upgrades to OW, PT $40; Vector Growth at High Margins
bullets.body: Piper Sandler transferred Unity to Overweight with a $40 PT (from $35), citing Vector growth at high margins and benefits from AppLovin success via long-tail publishers. 2027E model projects $776M EBITDA and $1.68B Strategic Grow revenue, with assumptions described as conservative. BNP Paribas also initiated CRWV at Outperform, $172 PT.

bullets.title: HOOD: Director Buys $20M Shares — First Insider Purchase in a Year; WonderFi Acquisition Closed
bullets.body: HOOD Director Meyer Malka purchased $20M of shares via Bullfrog Capital, marking the first insider buy in one year. Separately, Robinhood closed its acquisition of WonderFi and entered the Canadian market. Technical traders note bullish divergence on weekly timeframe but awaiting volume confirmation.

bullets.title: QBTS: Roth Raises PT to $40 on Analyst Day Confidence; AT&T as Customer
bullets.body: Roth raised D-Wave Quantum PT from $30 to $40 and maintained Buy following analyst day, citing dual-positioning in annealing and gate models, a recent $10M enterprise QCaaS win, and reaffirmation of two hardware deals expected in CY26. AT&T cited as customer testimonial. Gate model roadmap targets 181 physical qubits by 2028 and 100 logical qubits by 2032.

bullets.title: MDB: Wolfe Maintains Outperform, $545 PT; AI Native Cohort Building Material Upside
bullets.body: Wolfe maintained Outperform on MongoDB with a $545 PT (35% upside), citing AI native companies (18 identified) spending $15–30M easily and expected to contribute ~2.1% of Atlas growth exiting FY27. MDB trades at a 14% discount to Scaled Leaders at 9.3x EV/CY27 Sales.

bullets.title: META: Mizuho Bullish Ahead of Conversations Conf — Business AI Monetization TAM Expansion
bullets.body: Mizuho (Outperform) previewed Meta Conversations 2026 (June 3), expecting announcements on Business AI country expansion beyond Mexico/Philippines/Indonesia/India. Channel checks show Click-to-Message ads running at 3–7x ROAS and Business AI delivering 8–25% instant ROI for advertisers. SMB closed-loop product seen as the strategic unlock.

bullets.title: GNRC +9.8%: Hyperscale Data Center Backup Power Supply Agreement
bullets.body: Generac announced a supply agreement with a hyperscale data center operator for backup power, driving shares up ~9.8% in premarket. Separately, Bloom Energy CEO stated the company sees no need to sell shares to meet surging AI data center demand.

bullets.title: APP: Citi Adds to 90-Day Upside Catalyst Watch
bullets.body: Citigroup added AppLovin to its 90-day upside catalyst watch list, signaling bullish near-term setup. No specific catalyst or price target was disclosed in the note.

bullets.title: INTC: U.S. Government Holds 9.9% Stake; Computex AI Showcases and 18A Ramp Continue
bullets.body: INTC rallied 22% in a prior pre-market session after the U.S. government took a 9.9% stake in Aug 2025 at $20.47. At Computex, Intel showcased 18A process in full-scale ramp with 400+ PC designs, launched Xeon 6 Plus with 288 cores, and announced partnerships with Foxconn, SambaNova, Google, and Ericsson. Physical AI market projected at $25T by 2050; 40% of datacenter power demand expected to be AI inference by 2030.
